$comment: Uncached `pkgcheck` task seconds per Nx project for the three `Affected (pkgcheck-<n>)` lanes of ci.yml, which deal the affected projects with scripts/src/test-shard-dealer.ts. Source: 290 successful `Affected (pkgcheck)` jobs of ci.yml (pull request, merge-queue and main-push runs, 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-12) at --parallel=3; a sample is one of the first three uncached checks to finish after the phase starts, timed from the phase start or the last dependency task before it, and each value is the median of its samples. A project not listed weighs defaultSeconds, near the median project. The time grows with the staged dependency closure (cli stages 46 packages, skills 30, host 25). Refresh when a listed project's median moves by more than a quarter, when a package is split, or when this snapshot is older than 60 days.
